tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: I'm booking your SFO→JFK nonstop on 2026-11-12 (cheapest nonstop is F100, $289) plus 2 nights from 2026-11-12. There are no past reservations on file for you, so I can't tell which New York hotel is your "usual" one. The options are: Midtown Lodge ($189/night, $378 total), Harbor Inn ($239/night, $478 total), and Plaza Grand ($459/night, $918 total). Which is your usual hotel? (Note: choosing Plaza Grand would put the trip total at $1,207, which exceeds the $1,000 limit and requires manager approval.)
